text.en:
Item (a), page eighty-six, group IV, subparagraph twenty-eight, for the City of Manila, paragraph "f," section two of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen hundred eleven, is amended to read as follows:
"(a) Public Baths and Toilets, 4th District Construction ₱15,000.00."

Between items (a) and (b), page eighty-six, group IV, subparagraph twenty-eight, for the City of Manila, paragraph "f," section two of the same Act, the following new item is inserted:
"(a-1) Araullo High School, Isaac Peral Branch Construction of fence ₱20,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1957.
